rows.evidence: Nested outer/hole sketch profiles are reused for two distinct extrusions; a radius edit preserves curve/profile and body identities and measured annulus/plug volumes after cold reopen. Graphical editing acceptance belongs to the modeling UI track.
Native solver constraints and driving dimension parameter graph persisted and measured through a width edit after cold reopen.

Host adapter materializes current evaluated projection before break_link; parameter-edited silhouette detach has an actual source-engine regression test. Arbitrary missing-link relink is not implemented.
Construction plane and point Along Path accept structured geometric references, reject nested filesystem access, and persist across cold open.
Source-built box/extrusion fixtures and typed signed extrusions are independently verified through STEP. Not every advanced extent/taper/thin combination is accepted.

Original ring revolve, parameterized alternate-plane sweep and frustum loft have analytic measured volumes, independent STEP validation and parameter edits after reopen. Rails/twist/complex continuity variants remain unaccepted.

Counterbore and a cosmetic M6 tapped hole preserve expected removed volume and thread designation metadata after reopen. Modeled-thread fidelity and full thread libraries remain unaccepted. Legacy through holes migrate to symmetric native ThroughAll extents and remain through after thickness 3→8→−8 mm.

Four-edge constant fillet/chamfer chains recompute at 1 and 2 mm with analytic volumes. Impossible 100 mm settings fail atomically without reducing the requested size. Variable/G2/corner families remain unaccepted.

Curved open-top shell changes 1 to 2 mm with measured cavity volume and an 8 mm inner cylindrical radius; impossible 12 mm walls fail atomically. A selected face drafts 5 to 10 degrees against XY with analytic wedge volume. Original L bracket rib/web thickness edits retain analytic reinforcement volume. Coil and broader thin-wall variants remain unaccepted.

Rectangular body pattern plus mirror preserve six distinct body identities and recompute measured volume after a seed height edit; feature/construction patterns and instance suppression remain unaccepted.

Separate solids export as a compound plus distinct independently verified body STEP artifacts. Cut with Keep Tools persists both named bodies and recomputes measured volumes after a tool-position expression edit; bodies are never fused.
Open patch is preserved as a surface, exports exact area-bearing STEP, exposes topology/mesh, and cannot claim physical solid volume or mass.

Immutable STL import embeds an explicit mesh body, validates triangle geometry independently, and reopens without fabricating exact B-rep. Native STL exports all mixed-scene geometry; aggregate exact-format artifact keys are omitted when they would drop mesh bodies, while per-body exact STEP remains explicit. Scene bounds include every geometry kind.

Native expressions are canonical. Legacy profile dimensions and extrusion distances migrate into the same graph. Original v1 names outside native grammar receive an explicit persisted alias mapping; host value mirrors update through that map. Degree-unit host mirrors convert upstream internal radians correctly. Parameter renames update the alias and lock mapping, so later agent edits remain blocked.
Native numeric timeline IDs, edits, rollback state and project-level immutable undo/redo persist through Store transactions. Host sketch-entry snapshot supports cancel across processes.
Native model.faces/model.edges inspection and persisted selection context exposed; independent viewport face signatures are kept alongside native topology names, never silently equated.
Each exact solid STEP is imported in independent OCCT and checked for validity, positive volume and measured agreement; surfaces use area checks and meshes use explicit topology diagnostics.
Hash-checked immutable project STEP import embeds native geometry. Arbitrary paths, fonts, scripts, process commands, external glTF buffers and unresolved nested native links are refused.
Versioned upstream JSON canonical document plus source-native container/STEP artifacts retain editable history and cold-open behavior. General file format breadth belongs to interop track.

HTTP and Python/CLI adapters use one Store optimistic transaction path. Failed operations leave project revision unchanged; context-only selections avoid geometry recompilation/invalidation. On the first agent migration, the universal Store hook reconstructs the trusted canonical before-state and reuses native lock/binding guards; unchanged legacy provenance cannot mask replaced native bindings.

remaining: Full acceptance of every Modeling row requires the domain fixtures and graphical workflows; a registered command is not a passing parity claim.
Legacy features remain read-only migration provenance once the upstream document is canonical. Store guards and React presentation are integrated by platform/root owners.
Native body identity uses upstream feature/component IDs and persistent body names; renaming may change the derived scene key. Do not infer face/body correspondence from STEP traversal order.
Linked source imports are limited to one self-contained native design; nested external dependency packaging must be implemented before allowing that closure.
Native cancellation of an editing context imported without an Oxygen sketch-entry snapshot requires project undo.
Netgen and CAD remain in separate environments. Study support has its own multi-body/contact acceptance gates.
Native host installs the bounded CPU worker and advertises cpu-product/cpu-raytrace; actual image material/camera acceptance belongs to visualization track.

Build volume_mm3 and center_of_mass are null for scenes containing open surfaces or meshes; exact_solid_volume_mm3 reports only independently verified B-rep solid volume. Engineering checks reject mixed geometry rather than omitting bodies.
